test_case_text:
TC-001 Standard login
Verify a standard user logs in with the project defaults (standard_user / secret_sauce), reaches /inventory.html, sees the Swag Labs header, and at least one product is visible.
notes: Smoke validation of prompt-based credential inference.

user_story.i_want_that: I can log in with my credentials
user_story.so_that: I can reach the catalog and place orders
user_story.business_rules: The default password is secret_sauce for all accounts. locked_out_user must be rejected. A successful login redirects to /inventory.html.
user_story.title: Authentication
